description: Source code implementing PHY library functions for Realtek Ethernet devices, including delay utilities, register access APIs, and power management functions.

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_mdelay(uint32 msec)
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds, using either Linux kernel mdelay or OS abstraction layer.

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_udelay(uint32 usec)
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of microseconds, using either Linux kernel udelay or OS abstraction layer.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_write(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 data)
methods.description: Writes data to a specified MMD register for the PHY device, handling different implementations based on the environment.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_read(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Reads data from a specified MMD register for the PHY device, handling different implementations based on the environment.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_normal(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets the PHY device to normal (power on) mode via MMD register manipulation.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_low(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets the PHY device to low power mode via MMD register manipulation.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_pcs_loopback(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables PCS loopback mode on the PHY device.
